name: pactmark-docs
description: Static English and Turkish documentation for Pactmark

scripts.prepare: node --import tsx ../../tooling/docs/prepare-site.mts && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro sync
scripts.build: pnpm prepare && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node --import tsx ../../tooling/docs/check-built-site.mts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm prepare && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check
